errors.evidence: The image clearly shows circle markers on the blue line at each data point, consistent with the reference description which mentions 'малки кръгчета като маркери'.
The machine description does not mention the intermediate values of the orange line for 2014 (1828.2) and 2015 (1537.8), which are labeled in the figure and noted in the reference.
The orange line shows 2847.2 in 2020 compared to 2990.5 in 2019. While slight relative to the full range, the description omits the specific value 2847.2 and characterizes it imprecisely.
The blue line drops from 852 (2020) to 764 (2021) and then sharply to 436 (2022), which is not an entirely gradual decline. The drop from 764 to 436 is steep.
